description: Full record for the 25 Jun 1786 Hamre marriage of Anders Monsen and Urna Halsteinsdr (ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PM2). Mirrors the gedcomx already embedded in record-search-urna-halsteinsdr-marriage-match — same two persons, same Couple relationship, same date and place, no new genealogical claims. Exists for the same reason as record-read-gallo-1893-baptism: record_read is in search-records' allowed-tools and the skill sometimes reads a record it has just found, but ut_search_records_023 stocked only record_search fixtures, so record_read was never registered in the mock and calling it aborted the whole run as an unregistered tool (Type 1) — validators had already passed and the search work was correct. Coverage for record_read originally lived in ut_search_records_006, deleted 2026-06-18 as a side effect of a runlog commit.
